ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The main body in the figure is a six-membered ring, whose shape corresponds to cyclohexane. One carbon at the upper right of the ring is simultaneously connected to an upward OH group and extends a side chain to the right. The side chain starts from this ring carbon as one carbon atom, then connects to N=N, and the terminal end connects to a positively charged OH2 group; the curved arrow in the figure only indicates electron movement and is not part of the molecular skeleton. Reasoning: After ignoring the curved arrow, the molecular graph is a cyclohexane bearing OH and a C/N=N/[OH2+] side chain on the same ring carbon. According to the specified writing method, start from the alcohol oxygen and write it as O, connect to the substituted ring carbon and open the ring with ring index 1: OC1; add the side-chain branch (C/N=N/[OH2+]) on that ring carbon; then complete the remaining five carbons of cyclohexane and close the ring as CCCCC1. Therefore the SMILES is OC1(C/N=N/[OH2+])CCCCC1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the molecular graph visible in the image, ignoring all curved arrows: identify the six-membered cyclohexane ring, select the substituted ring carbon, attach an OH group to it, and attach the side chain C-N=N-OH2+ to the same carbon. Then convert this graph to SMILES by starting with the alcohol oxygen attached to the substituted ring carbon, opening the cyclohexane ring with ring index 1, adding the side-chain branch C/N=N/[OH2+] on that ring carbon, and completing the remaining five ring carbons to give OC1(C/N=N/[OH2+])CCCCC1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中主体是一个六元环，形状对应环己烷。环上右上方的一个碳同时连有一个向上的 OH 基团，并向右连出一条侧链。侧链从该环碳开始为一个碳原子，再连接到 N=N，末端连接到带正电的 OH2 基团；图中的弯箭头只表示电子移动，不作为分子骨架的一部分。推理：忽略弯箭头后，分子图就是一个在同一环碳上带有 OH 和 C/N=N/[OH2+] 侧链的环己烷。按指定写法，从醇氧开始写为 O，接到取代环碳并用 ring index 1 打开环：OC1；在该环碳上加侧链分支 (C/N=N/[OH2+])；再补齐环己烷其余五个碳并闭环为 CCCCC1。因此 SMILES 为 OC1(C/N=N/[OH2+])CCCCC1。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription from the displayed skeletal formula; it is the natural single route for this image-grounded SMILES question.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a cyclohexane ring with one ring carbon bearing an OH substituent and a side chain. The side chain is a methylene attached to an azo unit N=N, ending in protonated water/oxonium OH2+; curved arrows and electron-pair marks are to be ignored as instructed.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the required output is a SMILES expression and that the arrows in the transition-state drawing should not be encoded.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: encode the substituted cyclohexanol as OC1(... )CCCCC1, put the side chain as a branch on the substituted ring carbon, represent the azo double bond with N=N and directional slashes if matching the drawn geometry, and write protonated OH2 as bracketed [OH2+].
